Reasonable Hostel Price
Oct 2018 • Friends
I just found out that there is a small hostel for backpackers on the second floor of the restaurant after the staff introduced to me while I was having a meal there. So I decided to stay at their hostel for 2 nights after coming back from Halong Bay. The price was reasonable when it is only $5 for a night, including Vietnamese breakfast. The room and toilet was very clean and organized. I highly recommend this hostel for any backpackers who want to save money on accommodation.

Lively atmosphere
Oct 2018 • Solo
The atmosphere around the restaurant was absolutely lively on the weekend because it is near to the Old Quarter where a lot of local people come to spend their weekend here. It was a little bit strange at first but I got even more excited to explore the area and around Hanoi more after watching people around. For me, I love their spring rolls because it was crispy from the outside and the filling was savoury.

Vietnamese-styled Steak
Oct 2018 • Friends
The restaurant is very cosy and clean. There are tables in the front of the restaurant so you can sit outside and enjoy watching people on the street. I ordered a steak dish and it was served on special kind of plate that keep the food still cooking on it. I wish I could visit this restaurant if I had stayed longer in Hanoi. Highly recommend for everyone want to try a good and hot steak.
